summary_en: 1,600,000 shares (1.28% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥1.0B upper limit, open-market purchase via ToSTNeT, Aug 3–Oct 30, 2026. Execution under medium-term plan targeting 70%+ total shareholder payout ratio by year 3.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 28 July 2026, Prestige International Inc. announced a treasury share buyback program authorized by board resolution under the Companies Act (Article 165(3), read in conjunction with Article 156). The company will acquire up to 1,600,000 ordinary shares (1.28% of the 124.7 million shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an upper limit of ¥1.0 billion via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange under a discretionary trading contract. The acquisition period runs from 3 August 2026 through 30 October 2026. The company states this program supports its medium-term plan (announced May 2024), which targets total shareholder payout (dividends plus buybacks) of 70% or above by year 3 (FY3/28). The company has already executed approximately ¥2.0 billion in buybacks through FY3/26, and FY3/26 results showed record revenue and operating profit.
